data: What are the color(s) of arrows that point from right to left in the image?

The question asks for the color(s) of arrows that point from right to left in the image. From the caption, we know that the figure shows disambiguated FRMG output with depFRMG edges above and converted depFTB edges below. The arrows pointing from right to left would be the ones that connect nodes on the right side of the image to nodes on the left side. 

Looking at the image, there are several arrows pointing from right to left, and they appear to be colored purple. Therefore, the color(s) of these arrows is/are purple.
